'''Maddy Lewin''' is a [[wilder]] from the [[Two Rivers]].

== Activities ==
Maddy's [[channeling]] abilities start to manifest when [[Whitecloaks]] and [[Trolloc]]s attack the [[Two Rivers]] in {{ne|999}}.

She lived in her family's farm, but the Whitecloaks arrived and called all of them [[Darkfriend]]s due to her unusual powers. She buried her parents in the orchard, and then started hiding in the tabac shed.

[[Alanna Mosvani]] later has her enroll as a novice so that she can control her abilities. She has a [[block]] that she must be afraid to channel.

==Trivia==
Maddy only shows up in the [[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]]. Her exact relationship to the other Lewins of the Two Rivers is not specified.
